description: OMENZ Token Check (Base): is this token safe to hold or accept, before your agent buys, swaps or takes it as payment? Reads the contract itself: real ERC-20 or not, upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967 / OpenZeppelin slots: code can change under you), active owner and the powers in its bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist/freeze, fees, tx limits), owner/admin on the OFAC SDN list. SAFE_TO_HOLD / CAUTION / RED_FLAGS with every reason; regulated stablecoins labeled (issuer freeze is by design). Deterministic: no AI grades, no price predictions. Public chain data, never signs. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/token/check, $0.005 via x402.)
